title: I Asked Claude to Apply to 100 Jobs for Me — Here’s How I Landed 10 Interviews! 🤖💼
description: What happens when you let Claude, an AI assistant, apply to 100 jobs on your behalf? One user found out and managed to land 10 interviews within just a few days! In this video, we walk you through the exact process: First, upload your CV into Claude and ask it to act as a senior recruiter. Claude identifies the 20 job titles best suited for you and highlights the keywords that applicant tracking systems (ATS) look for. Next, it rewrites your CV into a versatile master template, making it easy to tailor for each role. Then, by enabling agent mode, Claude searches LinkedIn and Indeed for jobs matching these titles, builds a detailed spreadsheet with match scores, and creates customized CVs for every application. Finally, it applies to the top 100 matched jobs, personalizing each application to the job description — all while you focus on your day. If you’re curious how AI can revolutionize your job hunt, don’t miss this step-by-step guide!
